---
title: "Other research partners"
---

::: {.lede}
Established labs and research groups already running rigorous impact evaluations -
for teams that want outside technical support alongside EuroCOMP Lab.
:::

:::: {.cards}
::: {.card-e}
#### [J-PAL](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/)
The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab specialises in impact evaluation design.
:::
::: {.card-e}
#### [IPA](https://poverty-action.org/)
Innovations for Poverty Action designs and rigorously evaluates solutions to poverty.
:::
::: {.card-e}
#### [World Bank DIME](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/unit-dec/impactevaluation/about)
The World Bank's Development Impact Evaluation group.
:::
::: {.card-e}
#### [International Initiative for Impact Evaluation (3ie)](https://www.3ieimpact.org/)
A global non-profit research organisation collaborating with decision-makers in governments, foundations, NGOs, development and research organizations globally.
:::
::::
